summary.text: Kristina Ortez is a Democratic state representative from District 42 who has represented the district since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the New Mexico House of Representatives in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She is a nonprofit executive from Taos who previously led the Taos Land Trust.

paragraphs.text: Kristina Ortez lives in Taos, New Mexico, and earned an M.P.A. from the University of New Mexico.
Her career experience includes serving as executive director of the Taos Land Trust.
For 2025-2026 Ortez is assigned to the Labor, Veterans' and Military Affairs Committee and chairs the Agriculture, Acequias and Water Resources Committee.
In 2023-2024 she chaired the Local Government, Land Grants and Cultural Affairs Committee.
